title: Estimate when a shuttle reaches a pickup stop
summary: A campus shuttle app shows people waiting outside two times: a typical pickup time and a later time the dispatcher can usually meet. A road router already estimates the drive. Your team owns the correction for dwell time, queues at gates, and uncertainty. Design the service from a vehicle ping to a rider-facing estimate.

title: Price tomorrow’s unsold rehearsal rooms
summary: Independent rehearsal studios list hourly slots. Each evening, owners receive a suggested price for tomorrow’s open slots. They can accept, ignore, or override it. Design a recommendation service that improves realized revenue per available room-hour while respecting the owner’s bounds.

title: Decide whether to release a wallet transfer
summary: A ticket marketplace lets sellers move earnings into their wallets. An account takeover can redirect a transfer. A legitimate seller needs to receive their money promptly. Design a risk service that can release, challenge, or temporarily hold a transfer, including when a dependency times out.

title: Find emerging topics on a neighborhood board
summary: A local discussion app publishes a city board of conversations suddenly gaining independent contributors. A daily sports thread is large every evening. A bridge reopening can start with much less volume. Design the stream processor that decides which topics to publish, merge, expire, or withhold.

title: Route suspicious mail in a shared support inbox
summary: A support platform receives messages for thousands of small businesses. A fraudulent invoice in the inbox wastes staff time, but quarantining a real customer refund request can break a service commitment. Design a multilingual mail router that supports recovery from a false quarantine.

title: Find visually similar furniture from a photo crop
summary: A vintage furniture marketplace sells one-of-a-kind items. A shopper crops a chair from a room photo and wants available pieces with a similar silhouette. The identical chair usually does not exist. Design photo search so newly listed stock is discoverable and sold items disappear quickly.

title: Suggest product tags in a seller’s outfit photo
summary: A clothing seller uploads a photo and selects up to twelve products from the collection shown at a shoot. An editor wants clickable product tags placed on the visible items. The shortlist can omit a visible item or include several nearly identical variants. Design a system that asks the editor when evidence is weak.

title: Suggest introductions on a professional network
summary: A professional association wants a weekly list of peers a member could reasonably approach. A graph service already supplies potential introductions. Your team owns the ranking model and the final decision about who can appear. Someone who opted out this morning must disappear even if last night's shortlist still contains them.

title: Finish a training run on preemptible GPUs
summary: A speech team has one 40-hour reservation to pretrain a 3-billion-parameter encoder on 1.6 billion tokens. The training service owns sharding, data progress and recovery. Machines can leave during a checkpoint write. Define what a successful optimizer step means across workers and what can safely resume.

title: Track people at a loading-yard blind corner
summary: An operator display shows where people and carts were last seen around a yard vehicle. A camera and lidar run at different rates and occasionally deliver observations out of order. Design the on-device perception service that publishes time-stamped tracks and an explicit degraded status. Vehicle control is outside the exercise.

title: Estimate clicks for a sponsored listing
summary: A campus marketplace sells one sponsored listing beside a search result. Sellers bid in cents per click. The auction relies on calibrated click probabilities to compare eligible listings, including new creatives with almost no exposure history. Build the estimator and the logging loop that lets you tell whether its numbers can be trusted.

title: Decide whether a notification is worth sending
summary: A learning app generates reminders for followed workshops and saved lessons. Every candidate can be sent, deferred or dropped. Learners choose quiet hours and a daily cap. Design the decision service to improve useful returns while respecting these controls across phones and tablets.

title: Rank compatible accessories for a pickup order
summary: A bicycle retailer wants to show accessories beside an item in a customer's pickup cart. The catalog team supplies plausible candidates. Your service must rank useful complements, verify mechanical compatibility, and avoid sending shoppers to collect an item their selected store cannot supply.

title: Choose the next video in a learning session
summary: A video-learning service already supplies 250 plausible next lessons per viewer. Your team owns the homepage shelf. Learners abandon it when autoplay repeats material they finished or fills every slot with the same creator. Balance immediate viewing with whether learners later say the lesson helped.

title: Complete a station name as the rider types
summary: A regional journey planner wants riders to select an operating station before they finish typing its name. Misspellings and local nicknames are common. Stations also close during service disruptions. Design the completion service from publication of a station change through the next keystroke.

title: Answer shift questions with the current handbook
summary: Operations crews ask a handbook assistant questions at shift change. Answers can depend on the plant, equipment revision, and access group. Design a service that cites the exact source and can abstain when there is no authorized current answer.

title: Move a catalog scorer onto a nightly budget
summary: Merchandisers inspect a quality flag for each catalog listing during a morning review. The current service runs an always-on model on every dashboard read. You own a migration to versioned precomputed scores under a monthly budget. Keep yesterday’s dashboard usable while today’s scores are built.

title: Sequence the next tracks on a shared radio
summary: A listener starts a short radio session in a shared car. A licensed track pool is supplied by a separate service. Design the sequencing policy so a queue balances familiar tracks with discovery and responds to a skip without playing the same artist twice in a row.

title: Compose the first screen of a film festival app
summary: A streaming festival has a small catalog with staggered regional rights. The TV app displays labeled rows such as Recently Added and Documentary. Row producers supply scored, overlapping candidates. Design the page composer that chooses which rows to show and which films occupy the limited visible slots.

title: Rank a campus clubs feed before events expire
summary: A campus app supplies recent posts from a student’s clubs. A popular debate can attract reactions for days while a useful room change matters for an hour. Design a ranker for the supplied pool that gets time-sensitive information to people while respecting explicit mutes.

title: Triage multilingual clips with a finite review queue
summary: A community highlights app accepts short clips that combine images, speech and captions supplied by the creator. The policy team gives you labeled examples and a versioned rulebook. Design an upload decision service and human review queue for a launch in three languages. Editors can appeal a decision.
